text: Torque off buttons in the web UI for arm, base (the 4 steering servos) and head, 3 in total, each behind a confirm dialog; the group goes limp and its live torque state is shown.
"Record neutral" and "Re-enable torque + save" per group (arm, base steering, head): the new neutral is stored in the servo EEPROM (DefineMiddle), executed inside the running bridge.
Re-enable holds the present position (no jump); an arm re-zero marks the fitted arm offsets and home stale until re-calibrated.
Follower arm only; the UI warns that teleop needs the leader re-zeroed in the same pose (the leader re-zero is not part of this epic).

While a group is released its command sources are quieted (bridge, set_register, filter_node, swerve_controller, mcp_server, web_ui) so no goal reaches a limp servo and re-enable cannot jump; the set_register torque_enable=128 hole is closed.
Tests, READMEs and Ansible in sync, and a staged robot runbook that bench-tests head_pan first.
2026-10-20 gate: the gripper is excluded from the arm re-zero (neutral_exclude_joints: [gripper]); arm torque off still releases it
2026-10-20 gate: base release = the 4 steering servos; the drive wheels stay torqued and braked
2026-10-20 gate: two steps as designed: Record neutral captures and previews; Re-enable torque + save writes the servo EEPROM; plain Re-enable torque without saving
